Stealth.abilityCheckPredicate: DEX (Stealth) for independently legal hiding or moving unnoticed; DEX (Sleight of Hand) specifically to conceal an actual compatible small object from inspection.
Stealth.savingThrowPredicate: A save that an operative rule explicitly requires to resist detection, revelation of the wearer’s location, or an effect directly defeating their concealment. No generic “Stealth save” is created.

Flora.abilityCheckPredicate: INT (Nature) to recognize or assess plants, fungi or identifiable botanical material; WIS (Survival) to identify or avoid harmful growth; DEX for genuinely difficult non-harvesting handling of a delicate or hazardous botanical specimen; STR (Athletics) to climb actual supporting plant growth.
Flora.savingThrowPredicate: Directly imposed binding or obstructing plant growth, or an actual botanical spore/toxin exposure. The source being a Plant creature is not sufficient for all of its unrelated powers.

Poison.abilityCheckPredicate: INT (Nature) to recognize or assess an actual toxin; WIS (Medicine) to diagnose or perform an independently permitted treatment of actual poisoning.
Poison.savingThrowPredicate: A save directly avoiding or ending poison damage, Poisoned, or another expressly stated consequence of an actual poison exposure. Disease without poison does not qualify.

Unholy.abilityCheckPredicate: INT (Religion) concerning documented undead, an expressly identified curse or an actual necrotic phenomenon; INT (Arcana) when the governing task is analysis of such a magical effect.
Unholy.savingThrowPredicate: Necrotic damage; an effect expressly classified as a curse by its operative rules; or magical Charmed, Frightened or command effects directly imposed by an independently documented Undead creature.

Earth.abilityCheckPredicate: INT (Nature) to assess actual rock, soil or mineral material; WIS (Survival) to assess a present earth/stone terrain hazard; STR (Athletics) to climb actual rock or stone holds; DEX (Acrobatics) to maintain footing on loose or shifting earth/stone.
Earth.savingThrowPredicate: Direct earth/stone collapse, movement or crushing, or an effect explicitly applying Petrified. Not every bludgeoning save, metal object, or fall ending on the ground qualifies.

Strength.abilityCheckPredicate: STR (Athletics) for climbing, swimming, a genuinely checked jump, or forceful handling of noncreature cargo; a plain STR check to force, hold or move a nonliving obstruction or fixture under an existing procedure.
Strength.savingThrowPredicate: A STR save directly resisting physical force that would impose forced movement, Prone or physical restraint. This is not every STR check or save.

Psychic.abilityCheckPredicate: INT (Arcana) examining an actual psychic or mental magical effect; INT (Investigation) for a reality-testing check expressly permitted against mentally altered perception. Ordinary Insight, persuasion and general intellectual work do not qualify.
Psychic.savingThrowPredicate: Psychic damage; magical Charmed or Frightened; or explicitly imposed thought reading, memory alteration, mental intrusion or mental command. Mundane disagreement or social pressure does not qualify.

Arcane.abilityCheckPredicate: INT (Arcana) examining an actual magical effect, magical inscription or magical mechanism; an expressly required spellcasting-ability check to counteract or dispel an actual magical effect. It does not assist an arbitrary check merely because a caster makes it.
Arcane.savingThrowPredicate: A save directly against a resolved spell or an expressly magical effect, regardless of casting tradition. A magical creature’s ordinary physical activity and later independent mundane consequences are insufficient.

Cold.abilityCheckPredicate: INT (Nature) assessing an actual cold/ice phenomenon; WIS (Survival) managing or avoiding actual cold exposure; DEX (Acrobatics) for specifically icy footing; an actual CON ability check to endure cold under a governing exposure procedure.
Cold.savingThrowPredicate: Cold damage or directly imposed freezing/chilling exposure. An unrelated save in a cold room does not qualify.

Vitality.abilityCheckPredicate: WIS (Medicine) for actual diagnosis, first aid, stabilization or treatment of injury, disease or poisoning when that procedure permits the check; an actual CON ability check for physical endurance against exertion, exposure or bodily deprivation.
Vitality.savingThrowPredicate: A CON save expressly required for disease, poison, a Wound/injury event, bodily exposure, suffocation or physical exertion. Not every CON save qualifies.

Lightning.abilityCheckPredicate: INT (Nature), or INT (Arcana) for a magical case, assessing an actual electrical phenomenon; WIS (Survival) avoiding a present electrical hazard; DEX for an independently required noncrafting manipulation of an actual energized fitting or object.
Lightning.savingThrowPredicate: Lightning damage or an explicitly electrical-shock consequence. Thunder damage is not lightning.

Fire.abilityCheckPredicate: INT (Nature), or INT (Arcana) for a magical case, assessing actual flame/heat; WIS (Survival) avoiding or managing a present fire/heat hazard; an actual STR/DEX check to contain or extinguish a fire; a CON ability check to endure heat.
Fire.savingThrowPredicate: Fire damage or directly imposed burning/heat exposure. An unrelated roll beside a fire does not qualify.

Use the strongest within the applicable family once. Charges initialize once at lawful creation and refill only at legitimate Jewelcrafting dawn events under the shared guide. Transfer, equipping, repair, suppression ending, new scenes and copied records never refill or reinitialize them. This grants no AC candidate, even zero; no resistance, attack modifier, proficiency, extra hand, focus permission or carrying relief.
